acceptance_criteria.description: Done or cancelled checkpoint artifacts validate only when the exact repository path, SHA-256, and size exist in complete current HEAD first-parent history.
Active drift, side-branch-only bytes, shallow or malformed history, timeouts, symlinks, external and absolute paths, and missing files remain rejected.
Focused and full lab verification cover the checkpoint behavior without broadening run-report or evidence truth semantics.

objective: Make terminal checkpoint artifact validation match the documented exact first-parent history fallback while preserving fail-closed behavior for active issues and untrusted Git state.
title: Honor terminal checkpoint artifacts from first-parent history
